# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.24

Staging performance candidate dated 2026-07-25.

## What changed

- Patient filters, facets, counts, sorting, and pagination now execute in PostgreSQL before related rows are loaded.
- Dashboard cards use a persisted current-day analytics row refreshed every five minutes.
- Missing historical chart days are generated with set-based PostgreSQL aggregation and warmed in the background.
- RX workflow pipeline totals use one grouped database query.
- Five additive Patients indexes support the main list, eligibility, company-status, and date access patterns.

## Observed staging performance

On the annual stress dataset containing 5,000 patients, 12,000 RX records,
51,420 workflow rows, and 50,000 call attempts:

- 10-patient page: approximately 3.4 seconds before, 50-90 ms after.
- Persisted all-time chart: approximately 25-100 ms.
- Missing 30-day analytics rebuild: 531 ms.
- Eligibility summary: approximately 11-41 ms.
- RX pipeline: approximately 24-56 ms.

## Database impact

One audited additive migration creates indexes on existing Patients columns.
No column, constraint, patient, RX, call, phone account, proxy, origin, port, or
RX Softphone setting is changed. DailySnapshots stores derived analytics and
can be rebuilt from operational records.

## Validation

- Complete staging smoke suite passed.
- Isolated full browser workflow passed.
- 36 migrations applied with zero pending and verified checksums.
- Public JavaScript, dependency policy, and security automation checks passed.
- No high or critical npm audit findings.

This is a staging candidate. Do not install it in production until it is
promoted through develop, built, and published as an official checksummed
release.
